falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern would be broken as the August 2024 low was followed by a sustained grind higher, not a V-shaped recovery to new highs; this would indicate the current structure is a bear market rally rather than a bottoming formation, invalidating the pattern match

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below 14 would signal complacency and risk-on positioning inconsistent with a genuine bottom formation; the August 2024 bottom saw VIX remain elevated (15-20) for weeks during base-building, so this would prove the current signal is a false bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid driving yields sub-3.80% would indicate recession panic rather than soft-landing bottoming; the August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable/rising (4.0-4.2%) as growth fears peaked and receded, so this divergence would falsify the macro regime match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
